status.main_product: Drone survey and geospatial intelligence services
status.scope_reason: The company provides structural drone inspection services (RGB, thermal, and LiDAR) for infrastructure such as bridges, dams, chimneys, flare stacks, and cooling towers.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website services page, Flybi provides drone-based structural inspection of infrastructure including chimneys, flare stacks, cooling towers, bridges, and dams using RGB, thermal, and LiDAR payloads.

claims.claim: The company reports providing automated, version-controlled geospatial stacks and data-processing pipelines that utilize AI-assisted feature extraction for analyzing drone-acquired data.
claims.note: automated, version-controlled geospatial stacks and AI-assisted feature extraction

claims.claim: The company provides its proprietary platform, Flybi V7, which functions as a site intelligence workspace for asset condition assessment, enabling users to locate, review, and organize finding registers from visual and thermal imagery.
The company reports that its operating principles are regulator-aligned with Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) compliance and frameworks.
claims.note: operating principles are regulator-aligned with DGCA frameworks

claims.claim: The company self-reports that it is a DGCA-compliant drone survey and geospatial intelligence entity, and it maintains ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022 certifications.

The company reports providing drone-based industrial structure inspections using RGB imagery and thermal observations to generate engineering-facing reports, operating across 8+ active industrial sites as of 2026.
claims.note: operating across 8+ active industrial sites as of 2026

claims.claim: Official regulatory filings for Flybi Technologies Private Limited for the financial year ended 31 March 2025 show that the company reported a total revenue of ₹2.37 Cr, representing a growth of 92% compared to the previous year.
claims.source: Official financial filing data from TheCompanyCheck for Flybi Technologies Private Limited (FY 2025).

claims.claim: Regulatory filings from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) show that Flybi Technologies Private Limited is registered as an unlisted private company incorporated on February 8, 2022, with an authorised share capital of ₹1,00,000 and a paid-up share capital of ₹1,00,000.
claims.source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) registration profiles on Tofler, ZaubaCorp, and VakilSearch.

claims.claim: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) records indicate the company's board of directors comprises two individual directors, Raju Rajeshwari and Keshav Srinivas, who were both appointed at the time of incorporation.
claims.source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) records on Tofler and ZaubaCorp.

claims.claim: The company reports active operations across seven states in India, totaling 10 distinct engagements, as well as an office and corporate base in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
claims.note: The active operations across seven states in India totaling 10 distinct engagements could not be confirmed in the published records.
claims.source: Flybi Technologies official website and corporate filings.

claims.claim: The company has executed projects internationally, including a drone-based mineral exploration survey project in Uganda announced in 2026.
claims.source: Official company project history, case studies, and updates published on the Flybi website and official LinkedIn announcements.
